messages.subject: Accessing node numbers inside geom_point2
parts:
I have a question about how ggtree deals with subsetting:

I am trying to add nodepoints based on whether a given clade was found in 2 alternative trees, but using geom_point2 is giving some errors. The code is:

j_plot <- j_plot + geom_point2(aes(subset=is.monophyletic(j_tree,c(get.offspring.tip(ml_tree, node)))))

Warning messages:
1: In if (!node %in% tr$edge[, 1]){ :
  the condition has length > 1 and only the first element will be used
2: In if (!node %in% tr$edge[, 1]){ :
  the condition has length > 1 and only the first element will be used


The point of this is to use is.monophyletic() to return TRUE or FALSE to the aes subset, based on a list of tips from the other ml_tree using node. is.monophyletic(j_tree,c(get.offspring.tip(ml_tree, node))) returns TRUE or FALSE based on the node number used if I just run it from the R console

I think the problem is based on how ggtree processes the "node". How can I access the node number from inside geom_point2??

messages.author: f0dc0fdb872722c6
messages.subject: Re: Accessing node numbers inside geom_point2
parts:
you are trying mapping aes to an outer variable, see https://guangchuangyu.github.io/ggtree/faq/#use-in-aes

you can use %<+% operator to attach is.monophyletic() output  and then use them in ggtree. pls refer to the vignette.
